observations: Industrial sewing machine on a metal stand.
Brand 'JINLONG' is visible on the side of the machine head in photo 0.
The machine is powered by a foot pedal and a power cord.
The table has a built-in ruler and a metal presser foot holder.
The machine appears to be in a used condition with some surface dust.

claims.evidence: The machine is shown powered on, but the needle is not shown in motion and the internal mechanisms are not visible.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew through fabric or may have a broken needle bar.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be weak, noisy, or have a burnt winding.
risks.proof: A video of the motor running at full speed.

risks.risk: The timing of the machine may be off, causing skipped stitches.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a test pattern.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Video of the motor running to check for noise or overheating.
Close-up photos of the needle, bobbin area, and the underside of the table.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
